    , group_name AS group_month__group_name

    , restructured_in AS __restructured_in
    , transfers_out AS __transfers_out
    , restructured_out AS __restructured_out
    , voluntary_departures AS __voluntary_departures
    , involuntary_departures AS __involuntary_departures
    , retirements AS __retirements
  FROM `staysignal-project-id`.`staysignal_published`.`rpt_flows_monthly` workforce_flows_src_10000
)
SELECT
  MAX(subq_9.headcount) AS headcount
  , MAX(subq_15.hires) AS hires
  , MAX(subq_15.transfers_in) AS transfers_in
  , MAX(subq_15.restructured_in) AS restructured_in
  , MAX(subq_15.transfers_out) AS transfers_out
  , MAX(subq_15.restructured_out) AS restructured_out
  , MAX(subq_15.voluntary_departures) AS voluntary_departures
  , MAX(subq_15.involuntary_departures) AS involuntary_departures
  , MAX(subq_15.retirements) AS retirements
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(subq_3.__headcount) AS headcount
  FROM (
    SELECT
      headcount AS __headcount
      , month_start__month
    FROM (
      SELECT
        month_start__month
        , metric_time__month
        , group_month__organization
        , group_month__group_name
        , __headcount AS headcount
      FROM sma_10001_cte
    ) subq_2
    WHERE (
      ('__all__' IN UNNEST(@f_organization) OR group_month__organization IN UNNEST(@f_organization))
    ) AND (
      ('__all__' IN UNNEST(@f_group_name) OR group_month__group_name IN UNNEST(@f_group_name))
    ) AND (
      ('__all__' IN UNNEST(@scope_organizations) OR group_month__organization IN UNNEST(@scope_organizations))
    ) AND (
      metric_time__month BETWEEN @start_month AND @end_month
    )
  ) subq_3
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      MIN(month_start__month) AS month_start__month__complete
    FROM (

        , metric_time__month
        , group_month__organization
        , group_month__group_name

    ) AND (
